title: Fields of the World — Global Data (beta)
description: Beta release of the Fields of the World (FTW) global field-boundary predictions: 383,570,287 predicted field polygons as per-UTM-zone GeoParquet for 2020, 2024 and 2025, and 67,197 two-band field/boundary-probability Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs at 2.5 m (26.0 TB) for 2017–2025, hosted on [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/ftw/global-data-beta). Predictions derive from the [TGE Labs Sentinel-2 quarterly cloudless mosaics](https://source.coop/tge-labs/sentinel-2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaics/). One collection per year in each tree, so new years drop in incrementally. These are model predictions: a field here is a remote-sensing field unit, not a cadastral/legal parcel, and this is not a land-tenure product — see the catalog README for the limitations in full.
